scopeDecisions.notes: The operator accepted and completed the delivered session-first M2 scope on 2026-08-10. Supported beacon execution, complete cross-platform and real-server evidence, a central authoritative capability service, anchor-stable continuation cursors, loot dispositions, and their individual parity rows remain explicitly deferred rather than claimed complete.

The bounded managed-shell implementation is delivered for sessions and awaits operator acceptance. The pinned upstream command tree has no beacon shell workflow; reattachment stays within the same live client and exact main-owned workspace or dedicated shell window, while requested-unconfirmed PTY state, best-effort resize and close, mTLS-only evidence, and deferred cross-platform certification remain explicit limits.

WireGuard-enabled operator configurations and packaged helper certification are explicitly deferred; mTLS remains the M0 operator transport baseline. Implant-side WireGuard workflows retain their independently assigned roadmap status.

The session Terminal workspace starts the target default shell through a bounded managed stream. Linux and macOS request an upstream-unconfirmed PTY; Windows is forced non-PTY. Packaged-real and cross-platform evidence plus operator acceptance remain pending, so the row is in progress.

Selecting a managed shell attaches it directly. Reattachment stays within the same live client and exact main-owned shell surface; the owning workspace can atomically transfer resources to its hardened dedicated shell window, but generic windows remain denied. Reattachment after restart, backend replacement, or target loss is not claimed; operator acceptance remains pending.

The managed-shell workspace exposes confirmed Close and Kill actions bound to an opaque resource. Local closure is authoritative, while interrupted best-effort remote closure can leave process state unknown; packaged-real evidence and operator acceptance remain pending.

The session Terminal workspace lists bounded, main-owned managed-shell metadata for the exact owning window and target without output content or raw upstream tunnel IDs. Packaged-real evidence and operator acceptance remain pending.
